## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] docs — documentation
- [ ] chore/refactor — no behaviour change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` is clean
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` is clean
- [ ] `npm test` is green
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by a test (bug fixes include a failing test first)
- [ ] Works on phone viewport and desktop
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader labels are preserved
- [ ] No Epic Games assets, logos or APIs added
- [ ] Docs updated (README / PLAN / PROGRESS) when needed
